notes.title: Accessories Update is out!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

[h1]A huge new update just dropped![/h1] 

You can now [b]merge your pets[/b] together to unlock special accessories!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/6eb1ab85642f49a451b8ede16666e919162090ec.png[/img]

Every GibblePET comes with its own unique accessory that can be equipped on the [b]head[/b], [b]body[/b], or [b]hands[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/307caf997f016cedae386ff7dbabfe369479525d.gif[/img]
Accessories are tradeable, so you can share them with your friends!

We can’t wait to see how you customize your pets!

[h2]This update also brings two new traits:[/h2]

Holo
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/51cc65be3ec8eb19dbdef7454982df0494e591f3.png[/img]

Golden
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/9c3ee768cc510ee671bfadac95217c0406978ceb.gif[/img]

Oh and yes, you can now throw your pet across the screen :D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/6e5ece17a417f8faa2afa6ca1d1811212c62794f.gif[/img]

Lastly, check out the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/3090790/detail/51/]Traitbox[/url] available on the game store page, it guarantees a pet with a trait and helps support GibblePETS!

Thank you for playing, see you next time!

-Vokayl

notes.title: New features coming soon!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Today I'm here to introduce you to an upcoming update of GibblePETS!

I've made the pet window more fun by adding [b]physics[/b] to it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/6e5ece17a417f8faa2afa6ca1d1811212c62794f.gif[/img]

You can still lock it to place everywhere you want on your desktop


The new update also introduces Pet accessories as you can see from what Wicky, Golo and Ash are wearing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/307caf997f016cedae386ff7dbabfe369479525d.gif[/img]

These new accessories are obtained by merging pets together and every pet has its own unique accessory, can't wait to see your favourite combinations!

I've also implemented Steam Cloud functionality that will save your customized pet every time you open the game.
 
Also new traits are coming like this shiny golden one.
   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/9c3ee768cc510ee671bfadac95217c0406978ceb.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for news and I'll keep hearing your feedback!

Until next time,
 -Vokayl

notes.title: New custom Backgrounds option!
notes.content:
Welcome back to GibblePETS!
Following some suggestions to better customize the room, I've implemented a [b]custom Background system![/b]

In the decorations menu, you will find a new tab for backgrounds and a button will show you the folder where you can load your custom backgrounds! [b]Be sure to press the button again to see the images in game once you've added the image to the folder.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/f57ebe596ded3a9c7a0e33fa8d4813f4542ffe71.gif[/img]

I'm curious to see what your new ideas are for the future of GibblePETS!
Until next time,

-Vokayl

notes.title: New pets, secret pet!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm here to introduce you to this new update, that adds 6 new pets, as well as a new [b]secret pet![/b] Will you be able to find it in game?

I'm thinking of adding more pets like this in the future, let me know what you think and would like to see in new updates!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/1167df735318bff6ca78e01bc81e3b535e99da73.png[/img]


Until next time,
-Vokayl

notes.title: New achievements and community pets!
notes.content:
We're back pretty quickly with a new update!
You'll now get [b]achievements[/b] for unlocking/buying/trading a pet of a new rarity!
In case, you already have pets of a certain rarity, these achievements also work retroactively.

We also have [b]2 new pets[/b] from a community collab with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/loversonstreet]loversonstreet[/url]:
[b]Reve and Gibble Reve![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/1015dbbf6c1059217b87f178f0e91554aa3f9958.png[/img]


Stay tuned for new coming updates, and keep in touch for suggestions!
-Vokayl

notes.title: Community Feedbacks
notes.content:
Welcome back to GibblePETS!
A week after the release, I've been hearing about your suggestions;
I'm very open to users feedback and also ready for some collabs!
In this very small update, that works as an announcement more than anything else, I've added a community made [b]Legendary[/b] pet: [b]Kalen[/b] by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/xenoyia]Xenoyia[/url]!

Also hearing [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199524981968]oraoraballs[/url] suggestion, I've added a pillow to make your pets rest :)

Until next time!
-Vokayl

notes.title: Traits Tab!
notes.content:
Upon a user suggestion, I've decided to quickly implement a [b]Traits Tab![/b]

Now you will be able to check out all the possible traits for your favourite GibblePets even if you don't have that trait!

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1787858273669976/D58B8D5313B3C779245A4B75683745313056238E/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

I listen to any suggestion, so let me know if you have others. until next time!

notes.title: GibblePETS is finally out!
notes.content:
With a total of [b]40 pets[/b] and their [b]special traits[/b], the perfect combo is waiting for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/ac7f21c9ae4f3e6530a164cf4ce9e0373cc577e5.png[/img]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

Some features are planned for the future: 
[list]
[*] exchange 
[*] a sort of multiplayer
[*] more GibblePETS 
[*] more achievements
[*] and some secrets ;)
[/list]

[b]If you want to support this work to see these features implemented just play the game and have fun![/b] We'll see how this little project turns out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/bc8809c3e9dbaddd68bb2b2a70c2f494bf5452c3.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Language support and new traits!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome back to GibblePETS![/b]
I'm here today to announce lots of [b]language support[/b], that will be found on the store page. I've also decided to add a couple [b]new traits[/b] to spice up things:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/ac7f21c9ae4f3e6530a164cf4ce9e0373cc577e5.png[/img]


[b]Don't worry GibblePETS is coming out soon![/b]
Until next time with a new update :)

notes.title: QoL Update for upcoming release!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]
Thanks for all the support that you're showing for the upcoming release of [b]GibblePETS[/b].
If you're interested in following the development of the game, make sure to follow and wishlist!

That said, I've been working on some new furniture and making sure it all fits in with the style of the game :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/3313827e3ee2baf314249253c7498fd7efdc60d5.png[/img]

Like many of you requested, I've added a feature to better track item drops. Instead of adding a timer, for now I've opted to add this little icon that shows up on your windowed pet when you drop a new box!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309317/0932267a73786be5cfeb28f6682b406496f0d8c7.png[/img]

That's all for now, make sure to keep up on new updates!
